title: Price header and pasted-table fixes
notes: The Price XLSX Fixer now accepts a price column whose heading simply names מחיר, such as 'עדוכן מחיר 10.9.26', instead of failing to find one. Pasted tables also keep their columns lined up: merged cells are no longer flattened, a header row sitting in its own table is found, cells holding more than one line no longer break the row apart, and editing a long paste no longer silently drops the rows below the preview.
